turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll start with the question that matters: who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
"If I messed up." Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me, so there is no "if" about it. What did you do before you entered the zero?
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
You're asking me to go through your own mistakes for you? That's your job, Hale, not mine. Withdraw the zero, and tell me what you did before you entered it.
